guitar.evidence: Sam Fender is a singer-guitarist commonly seen with Fender Stratocasters/Telecasters in performance, but no singularly iconic documented instrument.

tone.target: bright indie-rock crunch with clean verse shimmer
tone.profile: bright indie-rock crunch with clean verse shimmer
tone.summary: A bright signal chain starting with a boost for initial grit, followed by a classic British amp model (UK 45) paired with a clear cabinet (UK Vintage 4x12), enhanced by chorus and delay for shimmer.
corrections: favor jangly crunch over mid-gain sustain

rig.name: Sam Fender - The Borders - Valeton GP-180
